introduction.en: Which Harry Potter character do your ordinary fan-club choices bring to mind? This independent edition uses seven limited angles: a first turn, checking a reference, easy company, a chosen role, a manageable start, an unexpected idea and a practical welcome. Twenty-one original situations involve harmless paper play, reading and shared activities, with no episode trivia. All seven complete public guides are available before you start. Character counts do not sort you into a Hogwarts house or predict magical ability.
introduction.zh: 普通同人社团选择让你想到《哈利·波特》的哪位人物？本独立版取七个有限角度：先走一步、核参考、轻松陪伴、自选角色、可做的开始、意外想法和实际欢迎。21个原创情境均为无害纸上游戏、阅读与共同活动，不考剧情。开测前可读七份全文，人物次数不把你分进霍格沃茨学院，也不预测魔法能力。

instructions.en: Think about an optional reading, paper-game or fan-club activity you would enjoy now. Choose one of four responses per situation, even if none fits perfectly. No answer earns bravery, intelligence or moral points. A character absent from an item is not rejected. Finish all 21 choices before counts appear; every highest tie keeps its full guide.
instructions.zh: 想想现在愿参加的可选阅读、纸上游戏或同人社团活动，每题从四种回应里选较接近的一项，即使都不完全合适。答案不赚取勇气、智力或道德分。当题没出现的人物不算被拒绝；21题全部完成才显示次数，每个最高并列保留全文。

scoreReading.en: Complete all 21 questions. Each explicitly mapped choice adds one raw count to one of seven characters, for 21 counts in total. Each character appears 12 times, three times in each option position. An absent character option is not a rejection. Every highest count receives its complete guide; all A gives three each and seven full guides. Counts are not similarity percentages, virtues, intelligence, magical ability or population ranks. A small gap has no validated psychological significance and cannot assign a Hogwarts house.

title.en: Harry’s limited fan reading

paragraphs.en: Harry is the central Hogwarts student whose adventures give the series its name. This edition selects a narrow, ordinary angle: trying a workable first step when a harmless shared activity is waiting to begin. It does not measure heroism, courage, leadership or how you would respond to danger. A paper-game choice cannot give you Harry’s biography, magical abilities or responsibility for a whole group.
paragraphs.zh: 哈利是系列同名主角，在霍格沃茨的冒险构成故事。本版只选一个普通窄角度：无害共同活动等着开始时，先试能行的一步。不测英雄气概、勇气、领导力或面对危险的反应。纸上游戏选择无法给你哈利的生平、魔力或对整个群体的责任。

title.en: The first clue on a paper map
title.zh: 纸地图上的第一个线索

paragraphs.en: Friends have invented an imaginary-school treasure hunt. Everyone has ideas about the route, but nobody has tested the first clue. You take a simple turn and let the others respond to what happens. Beginning gives the group something concrete to discuss. It is still reasonable to ask for an explanation, choose a different role or stop if the activity is no longer enjoyable.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友设计了想象学校纸上寻宝，路线想法很多，却没人试第一个线索。你走个简单步骤，让大家根据实际情况回应。开始带来可讨论的具体东西；仍可请人解释、改选分工，不好玩也可停。

title.en: A first turn beside six other contributions
title.zh: 第一步与另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Hermione checks the reference, Ron makes the game feel shared and Ginny chooses a part for herself. Neville offers a manageable way in, Luna considers an unusual possibility and Hagrid welcomes people and their practical needs. Harry’s selected angle gets a safe trial moving. None of these contributions is more heroic or morally valuable, and a tied guide is not a hidden identity.
paragraphs.zh: 赫敏核参考，罗恩让游戏有共同感，金妮自选角色；纳威给可做的入口，卢娜考虑不寻常可能，海格迎接人和实际需要。哈利角度让安全试玩动起来。贡献不分谁更英雄、道德更高，并列说明也不是隐藏身份。

title.en: Starting does not require taking over

paragraphs.en: A first move is useful when other people still have a real chance to shape the activity. Explain what you are trying and invite the next contribution instead of turning a trial into a decision for everyone. You can also wait when information is missing. A high count cannot establish impulsivity, confidence or bravery, and a lower count does not mean that you lack initiative.
